maria (Docs): Quick check — I opened a small PR to add a 'parse runbook' section and a couple SDK snippets for guardrails/structured output. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 Please review when you can. TL;DR: adds example flow for function-calling -> JSON schema -> parse fallback.

ajay (Eng): taking a look now. main question: do we want the JS snippet to show streaming + final parse or just final? I think both could confuse ppl.

maria (Docs): prefer final parse + note about streaming caveat. keep examples minimal. sample code: ```js
const resp = await client.chat.create({model: 'open-redwood-1', input: prompt});
const parsed = JSON.parse(resp.output);
// validate parsed against schema then fallback to 'unable_to_parse'
```

sam (ML): +1 on minimal. also suggest adding a tiny example of an invalid enum fallback so users see recommended guardrail: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["lookup","summarize"]}},"required":["action"]}
```

leo (DevEx): I'll update SDK snippet to use our helper `parseWithFallback` and add a short comment about streaming tokens not being guaranteed to be valid JSON. will push to the PR.

pr-bot: PR #4823 updated — 3 commits, 1 file changed.

ajay (Eng): left 2 nit comments inline about wording and a link to runtime behavior (KV cache + streaming). flagged for docs review.

maria (Docs): thanks! @leo can you make the change before EOD? We want this in next docs deploy.

leo (DevEx): done — pushed patch. also added a small example test in examples repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/commit/abc123 

sam (ML): should we add a short note on quantization impacts on schema validation? might be another follow-up, ok to skip for this PR.

maria (Docs): ok merging after green CI. @pr-bot can you run lint + staging deploy?

ci-bot: Lint passed. Staging deploy started: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/build/1592

maria (Docs): staging looks good. merging now. :tada:
